source_headline: Adolescente que teve o cabelo cortado após ficar com marido de amiga por drogas é morta a tiros na madrugada deste domingo (30)
source_original:
In April of this year, Tarciane Feitosa Félix, 17, made headlines on various portals and social networks after a shocking incident. The young woman had her hair cut off by a friend, in a supposed revenge for the victim's involvement with the drug-dealing husband of one of the aggressors, in the Água Mineral neighborhood, in the north of Teresina.

According to the police, at the time, Tarciane's mother was also being held in private prison, but managed to escape and called the authorities. The assailants presented two conflicting versions: first, they claimed that Tarciane had stolen items from their home; then, they claimed that the young woman owed R$1,500 in drugs. Videos circulating on social media showed the victim, who says she is two months pregnant, being beaten while being cursed at and threatened by the attackers. In one of the threats, one of the women said: "Lucky he didn't eat you, otherwise you'd be dead".

Two months after the incident, in the early hours of Sunday morning (30), the teenager Taciana and another boy were shot dead in the Água Mineral neighborhood. The police are investigating whether there is a connection between the cases and are working to clarify the circumstances of the deaths.
where_description: Água Mineral neighborhood, in the north of Teresina/PI.
